measured.source: 2015 laser scan of UP542 by the CMS survey team (report CMS-I-UR-0261 v3, EDMS 1568271; data EDMS 1568275; cloud re-registered in 2017; CMS pitch removed and the rotation the 2017 re-fit left free fixed by this study), medians over the scanned sections; walls straight from the floor to the springline, circular roof

design.source: CERN civil drawings of UP542, structure 3529 (cross-section LHC-DGS135294002): re-issued 'as built' by the contractor (Dragados-SELI) on 20 Dec 2004, with the section dimensions as designed

names.measured: section from the 2015 laser scan (CMS survey team)
names.design: section of the CERN civil drawings (2004), as designed
